name: Walk-forward margin from the verified results log
signal: bet the club with the better points-differential-per-game measured only over games strictly before tip-off, adjusted by the pinned home-court value
universe: games where both clubs have at least 3 captured games before tip
settlement_rule: SPREAD vs the originated line: the pick wins if the chosen club beats the originated margin by more than zero; ties (exact margin) are void
stake_rule: 1 unit per pick, maximum 4 units per game day
luck_policy: refused for any club outside the +/-2 luck band
